backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the store backend, defining data types and CRUD operations for products, orders, carts, bills, recharge orders, and user profiles, with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: A feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs and titles to their corresponding frontend files, component dependencies, and test IDs for tracking build requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence descriptions of each frontend source file, serving as a reference summary of component responsibilities and design decisions.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes, including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA with PWA meta tags, manifest link, Inter font import, and a root div for mounting the app.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Maa Bhawani General Store defining app name, icons, theme colors, display mode, and start URL.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle handlers for cache versioning.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes including home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin dashboard, billing, and admin settings pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: A route guard component that restricts access to admin pages by checking a hardcoded credential login (stored in localStorage with a 24-hour session) and verifying the caller's admin status via a backend query.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: A form component for adding new products to the store, supporting fields like name, category, price, unit type, barcode (with scanner), and image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with their image, name, category, unit type, price, and barcode, and allows admins to remove products with a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: A camera-based barcode scanner component that loads Quagga2 from CDN, accesses the device camera, and emits scanned barcode values with haptic feedback and optional torch toggle.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Displays a searchable table of past bills with options to view, print, or export them as CSV, using a dialog to render a full bill template for printing.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable receipt/bill template for Maa Bhawani General Store, displaying bill number, date, customer info, itemized table, and total amount with a shop slogan fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: A fixed floating action button in the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the store's number when clicked.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out sheet drawer displaying the user's shopping cart with options to update quantities, remove items, clear the cart, and proceed to checkout, while respecting shop open/closed status.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: A horizontally scrollable row of buttons for filtering products by category, highlighting the currently selected category.
A simple informational alert component that displays the store's delivery fee policy (free within 1km, ₹20/km beyond).
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches rendering errors and displays an error message with stack trace details and options to retry or navigate home.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying store name, contact info (phone and Google Maps link), delivery info, and a copyright notice with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top navigation header with the store logo, shop open/closed status indicator, admin dashboard link, cart icon with item count badge, and Internet Identity login/logout button.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main page layout wrapper that composes the Header, Footer, and CallUsButton around page content, and prefetches shop open status to prevent UI flashing.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: A form component for placing mobile recharge orders, supporting Indian operators (Airtel, Jio, etc.) with validation for phone number, operator selection, and amount, using the `usePlaceRechargeOrder` mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a UPI payment QR code image along with the payment amount and step-by-step instructions for completing payment via UPI apps.
frontend/src/components/PhoneNumberSetup: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders a single product card with image, category badge, price, and add-to-cart functionality, supporting both unit-based and weight-based (grams/kg) quantity input.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Fetches and displays all products in a responsive grid with category filtering, showing skeleton loaders while data is loading.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Shows an alert banner indicating the shop is closed and its reopening time, only rendered after shop status is confirmed as closed.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: Displays an alert dialog when the shop transitions from open to closed during a session, redirecting the user to the home page on dismissal.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: Admin toggle component that displays and controls the shop's open/closed status using a switch, with loading and pending states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context including login, logout, and identity state, wrapping DFINITY's AuthClient with a React context provider and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including products, cart, orders, recharge orders, bills, and shop settings using TanStack Query's useQuery and useMutation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind, defines light/dark theme CSS variables, touch-friendly utilities, thermal printer print styles, and a barcode scanner laser animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabbed navigation for managing products, orders, recharge requests, and bills, including order status progression controls.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page allowing the shop slogan to be edited and previewed on a mock bill template.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: In-store billing page for admins that supports barcode scanning (camera or manual) to add products, adjust quantities, and generate printable bills.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Customer checkout page that collects delivery details, calculates total price based on distance, and places an order with UPI or COD payment method.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The main landing page displaying a store banner image, a shop-closed banner, a mobile recharge section, and a product grid.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that retrieves order details from sessionStorage and conditionally shows a UPI QR code or a cash-on-delivery payment notice along with next-step instructions.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Displays store contact info, hours, delivery policy, services list, an embedded Google Map, and call/directions action buttons for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom OKLCH-based color tokens, typography, border radius, font family, box shadows, and accordion animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking existing features, known issues (stuck 'Add Product' button, non-functional barcode field), and pending action requests for Admin Dashboard redesign and bug fixes.
